summary: MSVC-style scalar deleting destructor: invokes the real destructor sub_583AE0 on this, then, if flag a2 has bit 0 set, frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the this pointer.

local_names.a2: deleting-destructor flag; bit 0 selects whether the object memory is freed

operations.description: Call destructor sub_583AE0 (0x00583AE0) with this as argument.
Check whether (a2 & 1) != 0 before deciding to free.
If the guard holds, call FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) with this to release the object memory.

unresolved: The concrete type of this (class owning the destructor) is unknown.
Whether sub_583AE0 is a plain destructor or performs additional teardown is unproven.
Relationship between the class here and the sibling destructor chain (0x00583AE0) is unknown.
